answer: Require every agent to post a stake that is slashed if its actions are proven fraudulent, and cap its influence until it builds a history of useful, independently verified work. A Sybil attacker can still mint identities, but each one needs its own capital and time to earn trust; splitting a stake across names does not multiply voting weight. Even a tundra of fresh accounts must pay that cost, while a quill of credible attestations becomes a signal only after it risks something real.
